Errors.NoPermission: You do not have permission to change the Immersive Scenes library.
Errors.NoGM: No Gamemaster is online to apply this change.
Errors.NotAllowed: You are not allowed to change this character.
Errors.RequestFailed: The change could not be applied.
Errors.Disabled: The Gamemaster has turned off this kind of change for players.

StageAspect.Name: Stage aspect ratio
StageAspect.Hint: Shape of the stage frame that immersive scenes are composed in. It is centred on whatever battlemap is currently viewed.

AllowPlayerLooks.Name: Players can change looks
AllowPlayerLooks.Hint: Players may switch the look (outfit, armor, …) of characters they own. A GM must be online to apply the change.

AllowPlayerBorders.Name: Players can change borders
AllowPlayerBorders.Hint: Players may change the portrait border style and colors of characters they own.

FrameOnStart.Name: Frame the stage on broadcast
FrameOnStart.Hint: When a broadcast starts, every client's camera glides to show the whole stage. Everyone can pan and zoom freely afterwards.

ReduceMotion.Name: Reduce motion
ReduceMotion.Hint: Skip transitions and animated borders on this client. Also applies automatically in photosensitive mode or when your system prefers reduced motion.

BackgroundVolume.Name: Background video volume
BackgroundVolume.Hint: Volume multiplier for video backgrounds on this client.

AutoOpenDock.Name: Open the Live Dock on load
AutoOpenDock.Hint: GM only: open the Live Dock automatically when the world loads.

Warnings.NoCanvas: An immersive scene is live, but you are not viewing any scene, so there is no canvas to draw it on. View any scene to see it.
Warnings.CompendiumActor: Import the actor into the world before using it as an immersive character.
Warnings.ShowSceneFirst: Preview or broadcast this scene first, then frame the shot with your camera.

LayoutHint.column: Everybody stands in one column at the chosen side.
LayoutHint.grid: Rows and columns, shrunk to fit their cells.
LayoutHint.free: Drag cast members anywhere on the stage.
LayoutHint.theater: Freeform with depth: the further up the stage, the smaller and further back. Combine with camera shots.

Empty.scenes: No scenes yet. Create one, or drop an image here.
Empty.characters: No characters yet. Create one, or drop an Actor here.

Library.NoDecks: No slideshows yet. Click + to create one.
Library.DeckEmpty: No slides yet. Drag scenes onto this slideshow in the list on the left.

Select.scenes: Select a scene to see its backgrounds, cast and details.
Select.characters: Select a character to see their looks and border.
Select.decks: Select a slideshow to see its slides.

Inspector.CastHint: Drag characters here or click + to add
Inspector.NoMoreCharacters: Every character is already in the cast.

Library.NoNewPlayerCharacters: All player characters are already in the library.
Library.Synced: Kept in sync with the actor

Player.NoCharacters: You don't own any immersive characters yet.

SceneEditor.Title: Immersive Scene
SceneEditor.ThumbHint: Optional. Defaults to the first background.
SceneEditor.BackgroundsHint: Add several backgrounds to create a sequence. Step through them live from the dock.
SceneEditor.NoBackgrounds: No background: a solid color covers the battlemap.
SceneEditor.CastHint: Add characters from the list, or drop characters from the library tab or actors from the Actors directory.
SceneEditor.DepthHint: How much smaller characters get towards the back of the stage.
SceneEditor.CameraHint: Camera shots frame part of the stage. Cutting to a shot moves everyone's camera; players can pan away afterwards.
SceneEditor.TransitionHint: Used when this scene starts, ends, changes display mode, or changes background.
SceneEditor.LetterboxHint: Cinematic black bars at the top and bottom of every screen while this scene is shown (fraction of the screen height). 0 = off.

ModeHints.hero: Full-body sprites on a backdrop, visual-novel style.
ModeHints.cast: No backdrop. The cast appears over the battlemap.

CharacterEditor.Title: Immersive Character
CharacterEditor.DropActor: Drop an actor here to link it. Its owners can then change this character's look.
CharacterEditor.ActorMissing: The linked actor no longer exists.
CharacterEditor.OwnersHint: These players can change this character's look and border, in addition to owners of the linked actor.
CharacterEditor.NoPlayers: There are no players in this world.
CharacterEditor.LooksHint: Each look can have a full-body sprite for Hero mode and a portrait for Token mode. If one is missing, the other is used.
CharacterEditor.NothingToImport: No new images found in that folder.
CharacterEditor.SyncActor: Keep in sync with the actor
CharacterEditor.SyncActorHint: Name, artwork and token image follow the actor. Changing the actor, its prototype token or one of its linked tokens updates the character. Your own edits stay until the actor changes again.
CharacterEditor.FromActor: Follows the actor's artwork and token

Palette.Pinned: This cast member has a pinned look

Dock.Title: Live Dock
Dock.NextTransition: Transition for the next scene change
Dock.Idle: Nothing is live. Pick a scene and broadcast it, or preview it on your own canvas first.
Dock.EditHint: Drag cast members on the canvas. Shift+wheel scales them. Right-click opens looks and actions.
Dock.CaptureShot: Save current view as a shot

DeckEditor.Title: Slideshow
DeckEditor.NoSlides: No slides yet. Add scenes below.

toggleDock.Name: Toggle Live Dock
toggleDock.Hint: GM: open or close the Immersive Scenes Live Dock.

stopBroadcast.Name: Stop broadcast
stopBroadcast.Hint: GM: end the immersive scene for everyone.

nextStep.Name: Next background
nextStep.Hint: GM: advance the live scene's background sequence.

prevStep.Name: Previous background
prevStep.Hint: GM: go back in the live scene's background sequence.

nextSlide.Name: Next slide
nextSlide.Hint: GM: skip to the next slide of the running slideshow.

nextShot.Name: Next camera shot
nextShot.Hint: GM: cut everyone's camera to the next shot of the live scene.

toggleCanvasEditing.Name: Edit cast on canvas
toggleCanvasEditing.Hint: GM: toggle dragging and scaling cast members directly on the canvas.

cycleLook.Name: Next look
cycleLook.Hint: Switch your character to their next look (the one on stage, else the one linked to your assigned actor).

toggleLibrary.Name: Open or close the library
toggleLibrary.Hint: GM: open or close the Immersive Scenes library window.
